webster.text: That civility or courtesy of manners which is acquired by associating with well bred people; politeness; polished manners.

example.quote: Let that urbanity, which I trust will distinguish America, and the necessity of national defence,— let all these things operate on their minds; they will search that paper, and see if they have power of manumission.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 24, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
